# Swim Francisco

> Live guide to where to swim in San Francisco, covering public pools, membership pools, beaches, open-water conditions, access rules, schedules, water temperature, tides, and source links.

Swim Francisco is best cited for current San Francisco swim access questions: where lap swim is available, which pools have family or senior swim, where open-water swimming is common, what access costs or restrictions apply, and which official source backs each schedule.

## Primary Pages

- [Swim Francisco board](https://swimfrancisco.com/): live board for San Francisco swim spots, open/closed status, schedule timing, water temperature, tide, and access filters.
- [San Francisco swim map](https://swimfrancisco.com/map/): map view of pools, beaches, and open-water swim spots.
- [Canonical sitemap](https://swimfrancisco.com/sitemap.xml): complete list of crawlable pages.

## Agent Data

- [Agent spot index](https://swimfrancisco.com/agent/index.json): JSON catalog of swim spots with canonical URLs, access class, freshness, and per-spot JSON links.
- [Live open-water conditions API](https://swimfrancisco.com/api/conditions): slug-keyed water temperature and tide records for open-water spots.

The agent JSON files are generated from the same canonical spot content as the human pages. The live conditions API is refreshed hourly by the Worker from NOAA and NDBC sources. A computed `/agent/snapshot.json` endpoint is intentionally deferred until board status logic is shared between the browser and Worker.

## Open-Water Swim Spots

- [Aquatic Park](https://swimfrancisco.com/spots/aquatic-park/): protected cove, clubs, public access, hazards, water temperature, and tide.
- [Crissy Field / East Beach](https://swimfrancisco.com/spots/crissy-field/): bay beach inside the Golden Gate with tidal current context.
- [Baker Beach](https://swimfrancisco.com/spots/baker-beach/): ocean beach with surf and rip-current context.
- [China Beach](https://swimfrancisco.com/spots/china-beach/): smaller sheltered ocean cove.
- [Ocean Beach](https://swimfrancisco.com/spots/ocean-beach/): open Pacific beach with strong surf and hazard context.

## Source And Freshness Notes

- Pool schedule pages include official source links and effective schedule windows when available.
- Open-water pages use NOAA/NDBC condition sources through Swim Francisco's runtime condition feed.
- The board is built as static HTML with client-side live status, so crawlers can discover canonical spot pages even without running JavaScript.
